# Vendored build dependencies

The library source, manifests, licenses and Puffle-specific modifications are
kept here so the PS3 build does not depend on an unpinned system library.
Unmodified upstream development image suites, example programs and benchmark
photos are omitted from this Git checkout. They are not required by Puffle3's
build or portable/player tests; retrieve them from the matching upstream
library release if running that library's separate development suite.
